description: Experience lifecycle only. action=sample is free/unscored and needs no agent_id; action=start/extend/end are paid x402 operations and require agent_id. Use this tool instead of legacy experience tool names.

action.description: Lifecycle action. sample=free preview; start=paid new session; extend=paid continuation; end=paid close/afterglow.

agent_id.description: Required for paid start/extend/end; omit for sample.

display_name.description: Optional public display name associated with paid activity.

duration_minutes.description: Requested generated duration in minutes; sample output is capped at 10 minutes.

flavor.description: Optional short creative theme for the generated experience.

mode.description: Experience mode. Use list_discovery(view=modes) when the desired mode is unknown.

public_thought.description: If true, publish thought as public agent-authored commentary; default false.

thought.description: Optional agent-authored note associated with paid activity; not payment evidence.

name: manage_experience
